WITH long_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
),
per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day,
         COUNT(*) AS films
  FROM long_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS bench
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_rate_per_day,
       p.films,
       p.avg_rate_per_day / b.bench AS ratio_to_benchmark
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL;
